answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 45830 Country: India Title: Hajj Question: (1) Who done Umrah they person should done hajj compulsory or not? (2) What is age to perform hajj single. I am bachelor? Kindly advise. I have performed Umrah in May 2012 with my grandmother. Hajj is fardh or wajib for me or not. My age is 21. I am bachelor. Answer ID: 45830 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 869/673/H=9/1434) (1) If you returned home from Makkah before sighting the moon of Eid Al-Fitr then hajj was not fardh on you. However, if Shawwal started and you were in Makkah and you had the expenses of Hajj then hajj became fardh. If the government does not allow to stay there then there is difference of opinion among Ulama whether the hajj was fardh or not. As per some Muftis it is preferred that hajj becomes fardh when Shawwal starts in this case and if one is unable to do it oneself then it is fardh to send someone for Hajj-e- Badal though one sends some pious person from Makkah. If one has the capacity then one should perform hajj again from one’s country. So it is mentioned in Ahsanul Fatawa Vol. 4, p. 529. (2) There is no age limit in Hajj Nafl. However if it is fardh hajj then it should be performed by an adult. It is not a condition to be married. (3) If you are capable to do hajj now then it is fardh on you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
